description: [$0.002] Look up public company financials, CIK, recent SEC EDGAR filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K), and recent news sentiment by stock ticker (supports up to 5 batched tickers). Do not use for crypto tokens (use token_market_snapshot) or open web search (use web_search). `tickers` overrides `ticker` to batch up to 5 symbols, while `include_news=false` skips headline sentiment to reduce latency. Live SEC EDGAR data, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.

fields.description: Return only these result keys, e.g. ["ticker","company_name","recent_filings"]

include_news.description: Include recent news headlines with sentiment for the company

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session token (x402s_...) from https://apix402data.com/pay after the 10-call free preview.

ticker.description: Any SEC-registered stock ticker (e.g., AAPL, COST, WMT, NVDA). Unknown tickers return 404 and are not charged.

tickers.description: Batch: array of up to 5 tickers; priced unit price x count

name: sec_company_lookup
title: SEC EDGAR company intelligence
